headline: OpenAI and AWS join forces as OpenAI models become available on Amazon Bedrock.

items.title: OpenAI models and Codex on Amazon Bedrock are now generally available
items.summary: OpenAI's advanced models, including GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, and Codex, are now available on Amazon Bedrock. This integration allows enterprises to deploy these models in production with Bedrock's high-performance inference engine, offering a streamlined path from evaluation to deployment. The collaboration enhances accessibility to OpenAI's technology through AWS's robust infrastructure.
items.why_it_matters: Tech leads can now leverage OpenAI's powerful models within AWS environments, streamlining deployment and enhancing AI tool development.

items.title: Travelers deploys AI-powered claims countrywide with OpenAI
items.summary: Travelers has implemented an AI-powered Claims Assistant utilizing OpenAI's technology, aimed at streamlining the insurance claims process. This assistant guides customers through claims filing, offers round-the-clock support, and scales operations during peak periods, enhancing both efficiency and customer satisfaction.
items.why_it_matters: Demonstrates practical applications of AI in improving customer service and operational efficiency in the insurance industry.

items.title: Holo3.1: Fast & Local Computer Use Agents
items.summary: Holo3.1 offers a new approach to deploying AI agents locally on personal computers, providing faster and more efficient processing. The release focuses on enhancing real-time performance and reducing reliance on cloud infrastructure, making AI deployment more accessible and cost-effective for individual users and small businesses.

items.title: Deploy Agentic-Ready AI at the Edge with Memory Efficiency in NVIDIA JetPack 7.2
